executiveSummary: The launch concentrated Google Ads into Brand Exact and a focused MCP Search campaign. The September 8 review checked all thirty-six campaigns and confirmed two enabled campaigns with combined average daily budgets of $65.75. The September 1 to 8 account total was $373.42, 142 clicks and 15,141 impressions, including historical activity in campaigns now paused. Conversion-goal alignment and accepted-form testing remain open; a staged tracking listener is not yet a verified live conversion path.

work.title: Client granted Google Ads account access
work.detail: Google Ads notifications confirmed a new user was invited by the client-side contact and then successfully added as a Standard user on the Nexla account.
work.whyItMatters: Account access was the gating dependency for launch; this is what unblocked it the same day.

work.title: Focused two-campaign launch reported
work.detail: The launch update retained Brand Exact at $25 per day and launched focused MCP Search at $40.75 per day, with all other campaigns paused. The update recorded Search-only targeting, the United States, and a weekday 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Central schedule for MCP.
work.whyItMatters: Creates a defined brand and nonbrand test within the approved approximate $2,000 monthly budget.

work.title: Campaign state and actual conversion goal reviewed
work.detail: The live review independently found the two enabled campaigns and the $65.75 daily-budget total. Both used a custom CRM lifecycle Lead goal, rather than a confirmed demo-request goal. Brand bid toward that goal; MCP used Maximize Clicks. Import reporting needed reconciliation.
work.whyItMatters: Prevents a configured CRM stage from being presented as a verified demo or qualified lead.

work.title: Form listener and spam guard tested in a staged preview
work.detail: The staged preview passed its listener and spam-guard checks. A test using a Gmail address was rejected by the form, so an accepted business-email submission and resulting lead record were not established. Production publication and live conversion success remain unverified.
work.whyItMatters: Moves implementation forward while keeping the remaining end-to-end test explicit.
work.sourceLocator: Dated September 5 working-session and staged-test evidence

work.title: All thirty-six campaign rows reconciled
work.detail: A fresh authenticated review placed all thirty-six campaigns in one table and reconciled every row to the September 1 to 8 account total. MCP Search and Brand Exact were enabled; the other thirty-four campaigns were paused.
work.whyItMatters: Provides a complete account read instead of extrapolating from one visible table page.

decisions.decision: Launch at $65.75 per day total, Brand Exact protected and a single focused MCP Search campaign, all other campaigns paused.

nextSteps.title: Agree the primary conversion and valid-lead criteria
nextSteps.detail: Reconcile demo requests, CRM lifecycle Lead imports and the intended optimization target with the client.

nextSteps.title: Complete an accepted form test
nextSteps.detail: Use an approved business-email test and verify submission, lead creation and the intended event before releasing the staged listener.

nextSteps.title: Review search terms and qualified outcomes
nextSteps.detail: Monitor the focused campaign and brand separately, then use verified lead quality to inform any expansion.

caveats: The account total includes activity from campaigns that are now paused and is not the result of the two active campaigns alone.
Daily budgets are settings, not a promise of exact daily spend.
Conversion reporting is pending validation. The staged listener is not claimed as published or validated in production.
Google Ads includes September 8 only through the displayed collection time. The current day is partial and platform reporting is not real time.
headline: A focused launch, with measurement next.
summaryFollow: The actions below separate verified changes, reported progress and work awaiting review.
